title: Castor module spec (pnpm scaffold -- --spec <file>)
description: A module spec inferred from a one-line business requirement. This schema checks structure only; rules such as "unique only for text and number fields" and "defaults must match the field type" are enforced by `pnpm scaffold -- --spec <file> --validate-only`. How to infer a spec: AGENTS.md "From a one-line requirement to a spec"; examples: docs/examples/specs/.

$schema.description: For editor hints; points to this file

name.description: Module name, singular English in snake_case (e.g. device, customer_order); table = name + s, API = /api/admin/<kebab>s (component_center: /api/admin/component-center/<kebab>s)

title.description: Chinese name of the module, used for the page title, menu name and API docs, e.g. 设备台账

dataScope.description: true when rows are isolated by department / creator (data scope)

fields.description: Business fields (id, created_at and updated_at are generated automatically; leave them out)

parentId.description: Parent menu ID; defaults to the 业务管理 (Business) directory (ID 1000) for admin, the gallery's 页面模板 (Page patterns) directory (ID 43) for component_center

menu.description: Only when present are the menu and button permissions added to scripts/seed-rbac.ts; new business modules usually use {}

en-US.description: Chinese → en-US translations (title, field labels, option labels)

ja-JP.description: Chinese → ja-JP translations (title, field labels, option labels)

type.description: str: General text, up to 100 characters (names, titles, addresses...); str50: Short text, up to 50 characters; str20: Short codes, phone numbers and serial numbers, up to 20 characters; str500: Longer single-line text, up to 500 characters (links, short notes); text: Multi-line text of any length (descriptions, body text); int: Integer (quantities, sequence numbers, ages); float: Number with up to 2 decimal places (amounts, prices, ratios); returned as a string by the API; bool: Yes / no; date: Date, YYYY-MM-DD; datetime: Date and time; file: Attachment (a file ID from the file center); image: Image (a file ID from the file center); enum: A few fixed options (status, type); options is required; dict: Options that admins maintain (category, source, industry); dict (the data dictionary code) is required

label.description: Chinese name of the field, used for table headers, forms, the import template and API docs

required.description: Required (NOT NULL, checked on create and edit); file / image fields can't be required

unique.description: Unique (only for str / str20 / str50 / str500 / text / int / float)

default.description: Default value on create; must match the field type (for enum, an option value)

dict.description: Data dictionary code of a dict field (e.g. device_category)

value.description: The value stored in the database (English, e.g. in_use)

label.description: Chinese label shown to users, e.g. 使用中

tone.description: Badge colour of this option in the list (default neutral), for status-like fields: e.g. in use → success, under repair → warning, scrapped → danger
